Label: Activity
Description: A Model Intercomparison Project (MIP) activity within a MIP era, such as CMIP, ScenarioMIP or DAMIP, that defines and coordinates a related set of climate model experiments. Corresponds to the ESGF activity_id facet.

Label: Author
Description: A person credited as an author of a publication.

Label: City
Description: A populated place, such as a city, town or village, as identified in the GeoNames gazetteer.

Label: ClimateZone
Description: A broad climate zone (tropical, arid, temperate, cold or polar) following the top level of the Koppen-Geiger climate classification.

Label: Continent
Description: A continent, as identified in the GeoNames gazetteer.

Label: Country
Description: A country or dependent territory, as identified in the GeoNames gazetteer, together with its ISO codes and country-level attributes.

Label: Country_Subdivision
Description: A first-level administrative subdivision of a country, such as a state, province, region or canton, as identified in the GeoNames gazetteer.

Label: Domain
Description: A named spatial domain over which a project or regional climate model is run, such as the CORDEX domains EUR-11 or AFR-44.

Label: Ensemble
Description: A set of simulations of the same experiment that differ only in their realisation, initialisation, physics or forcing settings, used to sample uncertainty.

Label: EvaluationMetric
Description: A measure used to evaluate a model, method, task or result, such as root-mean-square error, bias, correlation or skill score.

Label: Experiment
Description: A prescribed simulation protocol that models are run under, such as historical, piControl or ssp585. Corresponds to the ESGF experiment_id facet.

Label: ExperimentFamily
Description: A grouping of experiments that share a common protocol or scientific purpose, such as the DECK, historical or ScenarioMIP families.

Label: Field
Description: The research field or discipline a publication belongs to, such as regional climate modelling or detection and attribution.

Label: Forcing
Description: An external forcing agent or forcing dataset prescribed by an experiment, such as greenhouse gas concentrations, aerosol emissions, land use or solar variability.

Label: Frequency
Description: The temporal sampling frequency at which model output is reported, such as mon, day, 6hr or fx (time-invariant). Corresponds to the ESGF frequency facet.

Label: GridLabel
Description: The label identifying the grid a dataset is reported on, such as gn (the model's native grid) or gr (a regridded product). Corresponds to the ESGF grid_label facet. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: Innovation
Description: A novel contribution claimed by a publication or method, such as a new scheme, dataset or analysis approach.

Label: Institute
Description: The institution that develops a climate model or carries out an experiment. Corresponds to the ESGF institution_id facet.

Label: Instrument
Description: A measuring instrument or sensor that observes geophysical variables, such as a satellite radiometer, radar or radiosonde. Aligned with the NASA GCMD instruments vocabulary.

Label: Keyword
Description: A subject keyword or concept assigned to a publication, taken from the publication's bibliographic record.

Label: MIPEra
Description: A generation of the Model Intercomparison Project, such as CMIP5, CMIP6 or CMIP6Plus.

Label: Member
Description: A variant label identifying one simulation of an experiment as a combination of realisation, initialisation, physics and forcing indices, such as r1i1p1f1. Corresponds to the ESGF member_id / variant_label facet.

Label: Method
Description: A method, technique, model configuration or analysis procedure that a publication applies.

Label: Metric
Description: A characteristic quantity reported for a model, such as its equilibrium climate sensitivity, transient climate response or effective radiative forcing.

Label: Model
Description: Legacy class for a climate model, superseded by Source and retained only so that older IRIs continue to resolve; query Source instead. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: NaturalHazardType
Description: The category a natural hazard belongs to, such as flood, drought, heatwave, wildfire or tropical cyclone.

Label: Natural_Hazard
Description: A natural hazard studied in the corpus, such as a named flood, drought, wildfire or tropical cyclone.

Label: No_Country_Region
Description: A named geographic region that is neither a country nor an administrative subdivision, such as a river basin, mountain range, sea, gulf or ocean sector, as identified in the GeoNames gazetteer.

Label: ObservationalDataset
Description: An observational, reanalysis or reference dataset used to evaluate or drive a model, such as ERA5, GPCP or HadCRUT.

Label: Ocean_Circulation
Description: An ocean current or circulation feature, such as the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation, the Gulf Stream or the Antarctic Circumpolar Current. Aligned with the NASA GCMD science keywords.

Label: Paper
Description: A scientific publication about climate science, identified by its OpenAlex work identifier and, where available, its DOI. Papers are the provenance anchor for the extracted content in the graph.

Label: PhysicalFeature
Description: A physical process or property represented in a model, such as interactive aerosols, dynamic vegetation, an interactive carbon cycle or a prognostic ice sheet.

Label: PhysicalScheme
Description: A parameterisation or numerical scheme implemented in a model, such as a convection, radiation, cloud microphysics or boundary-layer scheme.

Label: Platform
Description: A platform that carries observing instruments, such as a satellite, aircraft, ship, buoy or ground station. Aligned with the NASA GCMD platforms vocabulary.

Label: Problem
Description: A research problem, limitation or open question that a publication, method or task addresses.

Label: Project
Description: A research project or coordinated programme that models, experiments and datasets belong to, such as CMIP6, CORDEX or input4MIPs.

Label: RCM
Description: A regional climate model: a limited-area model run at higher resolution over a specific domain, driven at its boundaries by a global model or a reanalysis.

Label: Realm
Description: A component of the Earth system that a model, model component, experiment or activity addresses, such as atmos, ocean, land, seaIce, landIce, aerosol or atmosChem.

Label: Resolution
Description: The nominal spatial resolution of a model, experiment or variable, expressed as a distance such as 100 km. Corresponds to the ESGF nominal_resolution facet.

Label: Result
Description: A reported finding or quantitative outcome of a publication, model or method.

Label: SimulationType
Description: A characteristic style of simulation a model is run in, such as fully coupled, AMIP-style (prescribed sea surface temperatures), nudged or time-slice.

Label: Source
Description: A climate or Earth system model: a named, versioned model configuration that produces simulation output. Corresponds to the ESGF source_id facet.

Label: SourceComponent
Description: A submodel of a climate model, such as its atmosphere, ocean, sea-ice, land-surface or aerosol component, usually together with the component's own version label.

Label: SourceType
Description: The category of a climate model, such as AOGCM, AGCM, BGC or CHEM, describing which Earth system components the model couples. Corresponds to the ESGF source_type facet.

Label: SubExperiment
Description: A refinement of an experiment that fixes additional initialisation conditions, for example a particular start year of a decadal prediction. Corresponds to the ESGF sub_experiment_id facet.

Label: Task
Description: A concrete research task that a publication or method carries out, such as bias correction, downscaling or extreme-event detection.

Label: Teleconnection
Description: A large-scale mode of climate variability that links distant regions, such as ENSO, the North Atlantic Oscillation or the Pacific Decadal Oscillation. Aligned with the NASA GCMD science keywords.

Label: Variable
Description: A geophysical output quantity reported by a model, such as tas (near-surface air temperature) or pr (precipitation), described by its CF standard name, long name and units. Corresponds to the ESGF variable_id facet.

Label: Venue
Description: The journal, conference, book series or repository in which a publication appeared.

Label: Water_Bodies
Description: A named body of water, such as a sea, lake or gulf. Retained for backwards compatibility; water bodies are represented as No_Country_Region instances. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: Weather_Event
Description: A weather or climate event discussed in the literature, such as a particular heatwave, storm, cold spell or extreme rainfall episode.
